en.title: Does a tumor-kinetic model add anything to a single early tumor change?
en.summary: At 16, 24 and 32 weeks, a mixed-effects tumor-kinetic estimate added no held-out survival discrimination beyond the observed one-point change, and carrying the last value forward predicted the next measurement best.
en.seo_title: Does a tumor-kinetic model add to one early tumor change?
en.seo_description: A mixed-effects tumor-kinetic model added no held-out survival discrimination over one early tumor change; the last value best predicted the next measurement.

ja.title: 腫瘍動態モデルは一点の早期変化より予測に役立つか
ja.summary: 公開大腸がんデータで一点変化と混合効果モデルを比較した。生存の識別能、次の腫瘍計測、計測密度と較正から、動態モデルの追加価値を検証する。
ja.seo_title: 腫瘍動態モデルと一点変化の予測比較
